objective.text: Reject a non-list associative payload when the API requires a consecutive numeric list.

difficulty.rationale: Reject a non-list shape instead of silently normalizing it.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An API requires items to have consecutive numeric keys starting at zero. The directly decoded input [1 => "A", 2 => "B"] must be rejected, not reindexed. Which rules enforce the shape?

options.rationale: Reindexing transforms the invalid shape into a list instead of rejecting it as required.
options.misconception: Reindexing transforms the invalid shape into a list instead of rejecting it as required.

options.rationale: An array can have arbitrary keys, so this permits the invalid shape.
options.misconception: An array can have arbitrary keys, so this permits the invalid shape.

options.rationale: The payload already has two entries; a count minimum does not establish its key sequence.
options.misconception: The payload already has two entries; a count minimum does not establish its key sequence.

options.rationale: list requires consecutive numeric keys starting at zero, in addition to the array requirement.

explanation.summary: list requires consecutive numeric keys starting at zero, in addition to the array requirement.
